watches.name: AUTO 2.0 - BAYDA EDITION
watches.description: Inspired by the desert’s stunning colors and surfaces, OOO - Out of Order® and 10tenlabs present the Bayda Arabia Edition, a collaboration offering a one-off exclusive 10 piece limited edition for the Middle East region celebrating the inauguration and launch of 10tenLabs. This timepiece features classic elements from the Arabian Desert revisited in Out of Order Style, famous for its patent in distressing the steel giving it a special patina which lets its timepieces look old, without compromising at all their quality. Sand effect hand scratched dial is here made to emphasize the beauty of this Territory. C3 SuperLuminova® hands are perfect to check the time, also in the darkest spots. Matte polished silver case back, with Arabian engraved majolica, wants to celebrate this incredible Italic-Arabian partnership giving you the chance to have a real piece of art on your wrist. Handmade ultra confy alligator strap with handmade multiple stitching adds a real luxury feeling to this Limited Edition, like it deserves to have. Automatic super reliable Japanese movement, PVD black crown and shock resistant buckle, besides the no-lens sapphire crystal with anti-reflective coating, complete the series of modern technologies applied for the creation of this Limited Edition, learning from the past but always looking at the future. These special finishing allows each piece to be a unique piece in the World and they completely avoid the “distressing worries” of who owns one of them. Each product is proudly made in Italy Certified and in this case, damaged in the magic Arabia.
